title: 10 Things a Godly Man Does in His First Month at a New Church
caption:
New city, new job, new church. And after two Sundays you already feel like a visitor forever.

Being known at a church doesn't happen to you. It's work you do on purpose for about a month, and then it starts working on you.

Go four Sundays straight. Sit in the same spot. Find the older man who's been faithful for thirty years. Stack the chairs.

"Not neglecting to meet together." Hebrews 10:25

Save this for your first Sunday.
